result.title: WorldFoundry: Towards Unified Infrastructure for World Intelligence
result.comment: 39 pages, 10 figures. This technical report will be updated periodically
result.summary: Visual generative models increasingly blur the line between synthesizing observations and simulating environments. Yet visual plausibility alone does not constitute successful world modeling: compelling outputs may lack persistent state, physical dynamics, or causally consistent responses to interactions. We define a generative world model as a predictive dynamical system that maintains a persistent, history-conditioned representation of an environment, updates that representation in response to actions or interventions, and generates temporally coherent trajectories that reflect outcomes under observed and counterfactual interventions. From this definition, we derive an intelligence-oriented framework spanning perceptual grounding, persistent state modeling, controllable transformation, dynamics-aware prediction, and closed-loop interaction. We present WorldFoundry, open-source infrastructure for reproducible inference and evaluation across video, 3D and 4D, embodied action, and interactive world systems. WorldFoundry unifies model and benchmark discovery, runtime and asset preparation, execution orchestration, artifact management, and interactive visualization, while modality-specific adapters preserve native inputs, execution semantics, output representations, and evaluation protocols. Explicit manifests, durable artifact contracts, and evidence-aware scorecards separate execution readiness from evaluative claims, making each claim traceable to its supporting artifacts. The catalog contains 270 model entries, 74 benchmarks, and 62 registered metric entries, with readiness and execution evidence recorded separately. WorldFoundry enables reproducible comparison of persistent, controllable dynamics across heterogeneous systems, advancing the field from perceptual synthesis toward measurable world intelligence.

AI.brief_summary: 论文先给出生成式世界模型的定义，即维护持续且以历史为条件的状态表示、响应动作或干预更新该表示并生成时间上连贯的轨迹，据此提出涵盖感知 grounding、持续状态建模、可控变换、动力学预测与闭环交互的框架，并发布 WorldFoundry 开源基础设施，统一视频、3D/4D、具身动作与交互系统的模型与基准发现、执行编排、产物管理与可视化，当前收录 270 个模型条目、74 个基准与 62 个指标条目。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「持续状态表示 + 干预下更新」的问题表述，以及用 manifest 与证据化 scorecard 把执行可用性与评价主张分开的做法，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态是否被实际使用、以及在反事实干预下如何取证评价提供概念参照，是否可迁移到 VLM 推理评测需核查。
